defect.b917_repro: chat received compact callback text 'review_ready' while the retained task_events terminal_review row and card['terminal_substatus'] were 'validation_failed'
defect.root_cause_1: src/aiworkhub/task_engine.py::mark_terminal_review enqueued the callback_outbox row with the literal string 'review_ready' as its transition, ignoring the substatus argument it was itself called with
defect.root_cause_2_discovered_while_fixing: src/aiworkhub/callback_store.py::_task_still_in_matching_terminal_state read a card['terminal_outcome'] field that is never written anywhere in this codebase; it always fell back to the generic canonical_status bucket ('review'), which coincidentally always normalizes to 'review_ready' -- so it only ever matched the (formerly always-hardcoded) 'review_ready' transition. Fixing root_cause_1 alone would have made every non-review_ready callback mismatch this recheck and be silently superseded (never delivered) instead of mislabeled.

callback_store.py: added resolve_callback_transition(substatus) -> str: the single source of truth mapping an authoritative substatus to its callback transition, falling back to 'review_ready' only for a substatus with no explicit failure-class mapping (e.g. plain successful 'exited')
added normalize_callback_transition(substatus) -> str | None: public wrapper over the existing private _normalize_callback_transition map, with no fallback, for direct introspection/tests

_task_still_in_matching_terminal_state now reads card['terminal_substatus'] (the field task_store.mark_terminal_review actually writes) instead of the never-written card['terminal_outcome'], and compares via resolve_callback_transition so it derives its expectation identically to the enqueue side
task_engine.py: mark_terminal_review now enqueues callback_store.resolve_callback_transition(substatus) as the outbox transition instead of the hardcoded literal 'review_ready'

chain_verified_end_to_end: task_store.mark_terminal_review writes card['terminal_substatus'] + card['terminal_review']['substatus'] = exact substatus, lifecycle status='review' (generic bucket)
callback_store.claim_pending_callback_batch / _task_still_in_matching_terminal_state accepts the batch (no longer supersedes it)

acceptance_evidence.requirement: compact callback for a worker validation failure emits state=validation_failed, never review_ready merely because the task is visible in the review queue
review_ready, blocked, launch_failed, scope_rejected, cancelled, process_lost and validation_failed remain distinct terminal states end-to-end
behavioral regression test constructs a task lifecycle state=review with terminal_substatus=validation_failed and proves the delivered callback preserves validation_failed
direct regression guard on the historical hardcoded-review_ready enqueue defect
public transition-mapping wrapper matches the existing private map (no drift introduced)

manual_end_to_end_probe.note: pytest is not installed in this sandbox; the exact chain (task_engine.mark_terminal_review -> real sqlite callback_outbox row -> callback_store.claim_pending_callback_batch -> callback_bridge.CallbackBatch.as_prompt_members -> build_batch_callback_prompt) was additionally exercised via a standalone python3 script against a real initialize_repository() temp repo before finalizing the test file

forbidden_regressions.callback_polling_loop: not introduced; batch claim/lease/backoff/dedup logic in callback_store.py is unchanged
forbidden_regressions.durability_bypass: outbox UNIQUE-constraint dedup, lease/backoff, and supersede logic unchanged in shape -- only the substatus source field and the added shared resolve_callback_transition helper changed
forbidden_regressions.legacy_AITools_interface: no import of AITools/taskdb.py added; fix is entirely inside the self-contained src/aiworkhub package
forbidden_regressions.raw_broad_grep_find_tree: AIWorkHub Source Graph used throughout; no grep/find/tree used for code discovery
forbidden_regressions.git_commit_or_push: no commit made by this worker
forbidden_regressions.task_done_by_worker: worker stops at review; does not call taskctl done
